sources.title: Kinetic Study of Ethanol Dehydration to Ethylene and Diethyl Ether in Catalytic Packed Bed Reactor Over ZSM-5 Catalyst
sources.authors: Narin A. Aali; Ghassan J. Hadi
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0, stated on publisher PDF p. 30
locators: Section 2, p. 31: conditions and W/F range
Section 4.4, Equation 37/Table 14/Equation 39, pp. 44-45: distinct concentration-profile model
sources.use: Closest match to CHEPTA's existing ethanol PFR example.
limitations: Rate/equilibrium parameter pressure-unit conventions require review.
CHEPTA upstream example omits Table-12 product adsorption terms; both variants now have draft runs.
Original experimental data have not been obtained; numerical agreement is not experimental validation.
sources.next_action: Review the draft source ledger and numerical comparison; resolve unit conventions and original experimental evidence.

sources.title: Integrating the Reverse Boudouard Reaction for a More Efficient Green Methanol Synthesis from CO2 and Renewable Energy
sources.authors: Juan D. Medrano-García; Marina T. Chagas; Gonzalo Guillén-Gosálbez
locators: Supporting Information, sections A/B: design and simulation results (identified, not retrieved)
sources.use: Baseline CO2-to-methanol plant: reactor, condensation, recycle/purge and purification.
limitations: Select the green-methanol baseline only; biomass and reverse-Boudouard sections are outside the first case.
Supporting PDF fetch failed; its detailed specifications and rights remain unaudited.
CHEPTA's equilibrium example is not the paper's kinetic PFR.
sources.next_action: Retrieve supporting information and audit kinetics, thermodynamics, stream specifications and column data.

sources.title: Multi-Aspect Comparison of Ethyl Acetate Production Pathways: Reactive Distillation Process Integration and Intensification via Mechanical and Chemical Approach
sources.authors: Branislav Šulgan; Juraj Labovský; Zuzana Labovská
sources.use: Detailed conventional ethyl-acetate plant for a later complete flowsheet case.
limitations: Uses NRTL-HOC and non-equilibrium column models; initial CHEPTA equilibrium-stage columns alone will not reproduce the same model.
Some property inputs originate in external databases; article access does not establish rights to redistribute those databases.
sources.next_action: Audit the conventional CSTR case first; map each property and kinetic input to an open source and document method differences.

sources.title: First-Principles-Based Simulation of an Industrial Ethanol Dehydration Reactor
sources.authors: Kristof Van der Borght; Konstantinos Alexopoulos; Kenneth Toch; Joris W. Thybaut; Guy B. Marin; Vladimir V. Galvita
locators: Tables 2–4: kinetic thermodynamics, operating conditions and performance
sources.use: Industrial reactor extension and tests of model applicability.
limitations: Microkinetic network and transport analysis differ from Aali–Hadi's two-reaction model.
The plant diagram is context; it is not proof that all downstream column specifications are supplied.
C3+ products cannot be silently omitted or replaced.
sources.next_action: Inventory the complete reaction network, species, catalyst assumptions and transport requirements before choosing a reproducible subset.

sources.title: Integration of the Process for Production of Ethyl Acetate by an Enhanced Extraction Process
sources.use: Alternative ethyl-acetate route and literature for extraction decisions.
limitations: Multistage extraction and distillation are not available at the audited CHEPTA commit.
Kinetic concentration basis, catalyst dependence and units need checking against the original reference before transcription.
sources.next_action: Resolve rate-law definitions and identify extraction specifications; keep this as an extension of the ethyl-acetate family.

sources.title: Effects of Reactor Type on the Economy of the Ethanol Dehydration Process: Multitubular vs. Adiabatic Reactors
locators: Publisher abstract and license statement; full PDF not reviewed
sources.use: Background comparison connecting reactor choice to separation needs.
limitations: Non-commercial license: excluded from the initial commercially reusable training corpus pending permission or a separate rights assessment.
sources.next_action: Keep bibliographic reference only in this release.

sources.title: Chemical Reactor Analysis and Design Fundamentals, second edition
sources.authors: James B. Rawlings; John G. Ekerdt
sources.license: Copyright notice; no open reuse license verified
locators: Example 4.2 (cumene hydroperoxide); 4.4 (generic PFR); 4.5 (benzene pyrolysis), as cited by CHEPTA
sources.use: Provenance of existing CHEPTA reactor demonstrations.
limitations: Free reading does not establish redistribution rights.
The generic A → B + C example must not be presented as validated industrial ethane kinetics.
sources.next_action: Review the relevant edition and obtain permission or replace copied teaching material with independently authored, sourced cases.

locators: Turkish Journal of Engineering and Environmental Sciences 25, 569–577; full text not retrieved
